app.title: Character Counter - Korean Text Tool
app.description: A free online tool that counts characters, words, and sentences in Korean and English text in real-time.

messages.app_installed: App installed successfully! Check your home screen.

help.title: Help & Instructions
help.input_hint: Type or paste your text. It is saved automatically.
help.usage_1: Type or paste your text into the input area
help.usage_2: Characters, words, and sentences are counted in real time
help.usage_3: Everything is saved automatically and survives a page reload
help.usage_4: Drag the bottom edge of the text area to resize it
help.shortcut_save: Save (autosave is on, this saves explicitly)
help.shortcut_mac_note: On Mac, use Cmd instead of Ctrl
help.transform_normalize_hangul: Compose decomposed Unicode Hangul jamo into complete syllables
help.transform_join_lines: Join line breaks within paragraphs with spaces while preserving paragraphs
help.transform_split_sentences: Start a new line after periods, question marks, and exclamation marks
help.transform_special: Keep only letters, numbers, and Hangul
help.transform_trim: Trim whitespace at both ends of each line
help.stat_excl_spaces_desc: Character count without spaces or line breaks
help.stat_words_desc: Number of words separated by whitespace
help.stat_reading_time_desc: Estimated time at an average speed of 400 characters per minute
help.stat_sentences_desc: Number of sentences ending with . ! or ?
help.tip_1: Use Export Stats to save the current statistics as a CSV file
help.tip_2: Use Google Translate to convert your text into another language
help.tip_3: Dark mode makes late-night writing easier on the eyes
help.tip_4: Try the extras too: spell check, typing practice, and more

typing.title: Typing Practice
typing.subtitle: Improve your typing skills across a range of modes
typing.description: Practice in Korean and English to build typing speed and accuracy, with WPM measurement and real-time accuracy feedback.
typing.mode_free_desc: Practice freely. Type whatever text you like.
typing.mode_beginner_desc: Learn to type while watching the on-screen keyboard — built for learning key positions.
typing.mode_special_desc: Practice numbers, symbols, and the Cheonjiin layout.
typing.mode_standard_desc: Work up through words, sentences, and paragraphs step by step.
typing.mode_custom_desc: Upload your own TXT file and practice it by sentence or paragraph.
typing.custom_desc: Upload a TXT file and it is split automatically into sentences or paragraphs to practice.
typing.custom_waiting: Upload a file and the practice text will appear here.
typing.custom_meta: The number of practice segments appears after upload.
typing.custom_none: No usable sentences or paragraphs were found.

salary.subtitle: Calculate your exact take-home pay based on 2026 rates
salary.description: Calculates take-home pay by deducting income tax, national pension, health insurance, and employment insurance from your annual salary, using 2026 Korean tax and insurance rates.
salary.non_taxable_hint: Meal allowance is tax-free up to 200,000 KRW/month (2026)
salary.reverse_conclusion: is roughly the annual salary you need
salary.reverse_detail: The target is first met at an annual salary of {exact}; the figure above is rounded to the nearest 10,000 KRW. (Take-home: {net})
salary.row_local_tax: Local Income Tax (10% of income tax)
salary.disclaimer_1: * These figures are estimates based on 2026 tax law and insurance rates, and may differ from actual amounts.
salary.disclaimer_2: * Results vary by individual depending on tax-free allowances (e.g. up to 200,000 KRW/month for meals), number of dependents, and other deductions or tax credits.
salary.disclaimer_3: * For exact figures, please consult an accountant or tax professional.
salary.err_annual: Please enter a valid annual salary.
salary.err_non_taxable: Please enter a valid monthly tax-free allowance.
salary.err_dependents: Dependents must be at least 1, including yourself.
salary.err_net: Please enter a valid monthly take-home amount.
salary.err_not_found: No annual salary matches the take-home amount you entered. Please check the value.
salary.hint_forward: Enter your salary in millions of KRW (e.g. 50 → 50,000,000 KRW)
salary.hint_reverse: Enter monthly take-home in units of 10,000 KRW (e.g. 300 → 3,000,000 KRW)
